I will keep my public message consistent with my prior rejection of $150 and avoid revealing exact survival math. I will not counter the offer, even with a lowball bid, because giving up properties or risking a risky trade is not worth the cash. Player 3 may sell Baltic to player 4.

Player 4 is the cash leader and may not want to fund player 3's dark blue houses. The orange danger remains more urgent than the brown monopoly. I will reject the offer and close the door entirely.
